SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No.
Section 1, Special Branch. 5640/1/
REPORT
Date June 22, 1939.
Subject Communication dated 7-6-39 from the Netherlands Consulate-General
concerning Dr. I. Werbner.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev    Forwarded by
Enquiries show that Izydor WERBNER, Polish
citizen of Jewish origin, arrived in Shanghai from
Europe on March 3, 1939 aboard the m.v. "Aramis".
He left for the South on June 8 in the s.s. "Taisang".
This individual is registered with the
Jewish Refugees Relief Committee, 190 Kiukiang Road
(Reg. 1678) where he is known as Dr. Werbner.
Mr. Sand of the United Piece Goods Company,
320 Szechuen Road, was communicated with in
connection with this enquiry. Asked if any
person named Isidor Werbner was associated with
his company, he replied in the negative.
Nothing detrimental is known regarding
I. Werbner at the Jewish Refugees Relief Committee
and while in Shanghai he did not come to Police
notice.
A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.
D.C. (Special Branch)

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案号
特务科第一股。 5640/1/
报告
日期：1939年6月22日。
事由：荷兰总领事馆于1939年6月7日来函，涉及I. Werbner博士。
由特务督察普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）呈报    转呈
经查，Izydor WERBNER，波兰公民，犹太裔，于1939年3月3日乘“阿拉米斯”号（m.v. "Aramis"）轮船从欧洲抵达上海。他于6月8日乘“泰山”号（s.s. "Taisang"）轮船前往南方。
此人在九江路190号犹太难民救济委员会登记（登记号1678），在该处被称为Werbner博士。
就此次查询事宜，已与四川路320号联合布匹公司（United Piece Goods Company）的Sand先生取得联系。当问及该公司是否有任何名为Isidor Werbner的人员与其有关联时，他予以否认。
在犹太难民救济委员会方面，未掌握关于I. Werbner的任何不利信息，且其在沪期间并未引起警方注意。
A. Prokofiev
特务督察
副巡官（特务科）

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No.1789. SHANGHAI, 7th June 1939.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Mr.Isydor WERBNER
has applied to this Consulate-General for a visa for admission
into the Netherlands Indies.

Mr.Werbner is the holder of a valid Polish passport issued
at Lwow on the 1st December 1932, Serie 1 No.279918 No.BA
5/2900/32, extended at Milan and at Rome till 31st December 1939.

Mr.Werbner stated that he arrived in Shanghai approximately
3 months ago from Italy and that he intended to leave on the 6th
instant by the m.v. Aramis for Hongkong.

He also wished to proceed to Batavia afterwards and to stay
there for one month. On account of his early departure he was
advised to apply for a visa with the Netherlands Consulate-General
at Singapore.

Mr.Werbner informed me that he has relations with Messrs.
United Piece Goods Co. of 320 Szechuen Road. Inquiries made
at the local office of the Messageries Maritimes revealed how-
ever that he did not book any passage.

He resides at 1272 Avenue Joffre, House 11, telephone
No.77309.

I should feel greatly obliged to you if you would let me
know, if possible, whether anything is known against this person
from a political or moral point of view.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Consul-General.

The Deputy Commissioner
Special Branch,Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电报挂号：HOLLANDIA。

第1789号。 上海，1939年6月7日。

先生：

谨通知阁下，Isydor WERBNER先生已向本总领事馆申请进入荷属东印度的签证。

Werber先生持有一本有效的波兰护照，该护照于1932年12月1日在利沃夫（Lwow）签发，系列1，编号279918，编号BA 5/2900/32，并在米兰和罗马延期至1939年12月31日。

Werbner先生称，他大约3个月前从意大利抵达上海，并打算于本月6日乘“阿拉米斯”号轮船前往香港。

他还希望随后前往巴达维亚（Batavia），并在那里停留一个月。鉴于其启程在即，已建议他向新加坡荷兰总领事馆申请签证。

Werbner先生告知我，他与四川路320号的联合布匹公司（United Piece Goods Co.）有关系人。然而，经向当地法国邮船公司（Messageries Maritimes）办事处查询，发现他并未预订任何船票。

他居住在霞飞路1272弄11号，电话号码77309。

如蒙告知，从政治或道德角度是否知悉此人有任何不良记录，本人将不胜感激。

谨此致意，

先生，

您顺从的仆人，

总领事。

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特务科副巡官，
上海。
